programme.title: Cold Blood scènes de crime
programme.desc: Un meurtre a été commis et, à mesure que les preuves s'accumulent, la confusion s'installe. La science médico-légale peut-elle révéler la vérité ?

programme.desc: Au cœur de l'enquête avec les experts de la police scientifique

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Détectives
programme.desc: Au cœur de l'enquête avec les experts de la police scientifique

programme.title: Face au Crime
programme.desc: Le 7 mai 2008 à Marseille, Fatima Saiah, une lycéenne de 20, disparaît alors qu’elle avait rendez-vous avec un inconnu qui lui proposait de garder ses deux petites filles. Plus de 7 ans après, les parents de la disparue gardent un espoir de revoir leur fille vivante. Pour eux le fiancé de leur fille reste le principal suspect dans cette affaire. Ce n’est pas l’avis de la brigade criminelle de Marseille. Pour les enquêteurs, l’homme à l’origine de la disparition n’est autre que le tueur en série Patrick Salameh.

programme.title: Face au Crime
programme.desc: Juin 2015. Montauban. La cour d’assises juge en appel Frédérique Sapotille accusé d’avoir poignardé à mort Christelle Castillon son ex-compagne à Toulouse. L’accusé plaide l’accident après la séparation. Ce n’est pas l’avis de l’accusation qui estime que tout était prémédité et qu’il s’agit d’un assassinat. Au fil de l’audience, les jurés découvrent comment l’ancien concubin aurait espionné, et surveillé la victime qui vivait dans la peur… L’accusé a-t-il commis un crime presque parfait ?

programme.title: Alliance meurtrière
programme.desc: Donald Fish, arnaqueur dans une salle de billard, ne mesure qu'un mètre quatre-vingt et n'est pas de taille face à deux lesbiennes vicieuses qui ont élaboré un plan pour le séduire avant d'utiliser la violence pour lui voler son argent. Les enquêteurs parviendront-ils à retrouver le duo avant qu'il ne frappe à nouveau ?

programme.title: Décompte Mortel
programme.desc: Alors que les détectives enquêtent sur le meurtre brutal d'un barman de Tampa, ce sont les notes manuscrites de la victime qui font exploser l'affaire, et l'équipe se rapproche bientôt d'un prédateur manipulateur qui a habilement externalisé ses ambitions sanguinaires.

programme.title: Décompte Mortel
programme.desc: Un incendie médiatique éclate à Macon, en Géorgie, lorsque le torse démembré d'une étudiante en droit populaire est découvert dans une poubelle à l'extérieur de sa maison. Des dizaines d'enquêteurs sont appelés pour amplifier l'enquête, et la recherche est lancée pour un harceleur sanguinaire ayant accès à son appartement.

programme.title: Dans l’ombre d’Epstein, l’affaire Ghislaine Maxwell
programme.desc: Héritière d’un empire médiatique, Ghislaine Maxwell grandit sous l’emprise d’un père autoritaire. Cet épisode explore son passé et les événements qui la conduiront dans l’ombre de Jeffrey Epstein.

programme.title: Dans l’ombre d’Epstein, l’affaire Ghislaine Maxwell
programme.desc: Après la mort de son père, Ghislaine part pour New York et rencontre Jeffrey Epstein. Compagne, employée et proche collaboratrice, elle est accusée d’avoir joué un rôle central dans son réseau criminel.

programme.title: Dans l’ombre d’Epstein, l’affaire Ghislaine Maxwell
programme.desc: Après des années passées à prendre ses distances avec Epstein, Ghislaine Maxwell disparaît de la vie publique. Rattrapée par les accusations, elle est arrêtée et doit désormais répondre de ses actes devant la justice.

programme.desc: En 1976, le premier de quatre enfants est enlevé et assassiné dans la banlieue de Detroit. Plus de 30 ans plus tard, l’affaire reste non résolue, et J. Reuben Appelman, un habitant de Detroit, est déterminé à élucider le mystère. En épluchant les dossiers originaux, Appelman découvre des indices et des occasions manquées. Y avait-il un lien avec un réseau pédophile opérant un camp pour garçons sur une île isolée du lac Michigan ?

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: Straight from The Orchard at Jigsaw Health, Tuesday Night Pickleball brings you a high-octane women’s doubles matchup featuring four elite pros. Anna Bright and Jessie Irvine team up with firepower and finesse to take on the seasoned duo of Lucy Kovalova and Catherine Parenteau.From smart stacking and sharp cross-court dinks to quick hands battles and momentum swings, this match is packed with elite-level tactics and crowd-thrilling rallies. It’s classic TNP: fun, fiery, and full of flair.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: In this intense Gold Medal Match from the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships, Marcello Jardim takes on Marco Osorio in a thrilling Men’s Pro Singles showdown. With sharp baseline play, quick hands at the net, and relentless rallies, this match captures the competitive spirit and elite talent of pro pickleball at its finest.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2023
programme.desc: Pickleball star JW Johnson & pro football player Marcellus Wiley team up against pro-pickler Jorja Johnson & film director and producer John Brenkus.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The grand finale of the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional Championship, the second of six regionals for the season. The rivalry matchup features the top teams from Utah Valley University and Utah Tech.This broadcast highlights the intense Men's Doubles game, where Utah Tech's star player Liam Duffin—hailed as one of the top collegiate players nationwide—teams up with Clayton Boydston to face Utah Valley's duo of Bryce Larson and Charles Case.The stakes are high: teams are competing for $5,000 in scholarship money and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri, where $30,000 is on the line. Ultimately, Utah Tech's first team prevails, taking home the national bid and the Utah Regional title.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.desc: In the finals of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, the Fort Myers Flamingos and the GMV Chomp go head-to-head. The commentators, including Angel, highlight the youth and fire of Fort Myers player Jade and the consistent dominance of the number one women's team, the GMV Chomp. The match is a best-of-three, rally-scoring format with games to 21. The episode showcases impressive plays from Stevie and Kelsey, and praises Heather Nobler's "nasty" two-handed backhand. The commentators also discuss the challenge for the team coming out of pool number two, which has less rest time before the finals.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Catch all the action from the Women's Senior Pro Doubles Semifinal 1 at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships held in Naples, Florida. This semifinal match features top senior pros Nathalie Bagby and Beth Bellamy facing Jennifer Dawson and Bonnie Williams in a high-stakes contest. Expert commentary highlights key strategies, player strengths, and match dynamics including powerful serves from Ava Welsher, tactical lobs, and intense court positioning. Follow how the players adjust to crowd pressure and timeouts in this best-of-three game format. Get ready for a thrilling showdown in one of pickleball’s premier senior pro events.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The Arch Pickleball Center in Saint Louis sets the stage for a high-stakes National Championship showdown between the FAU Owls and the UCSD Tritons. Fresh off a dominant semifinal run, FAU brings an imposing lineup of heavy hitters who push the pace with "racing" intensity and technical "skills" that have kept opponents off-balance all weekend. UCSD enters the finals as a battle-tested squad, having survived a grueling seven-game sudden-death thriller to earn their spot on center court. This match highlights the "freestyle" adaptability of these elite student-athletes as they battle through mental fatigue and physical exhaustion for the ultimate collegiate title.

programme.title: Pickleball England
programme.desc: This thrilling Group C matchup in the Men’s Doubles Open division features Edward Turney & Ben Cawston against Auto Stephens & Nick Hobbis. Filmed at the Bolton Arena during the 2023 English Nationals, the match showcases intense volleys, smart shot selection, and some of the best defensive play of the tournament. Don’t miss this showdown from the heart of England’s pickleball scene.

programme.title: Pickleball England
programme.desc: Catch the final showdown from the 2023 English Nationals as Mollie Kubrick-Finney and Thaddea Lock challenge reigning champs Antonella Giuliano and Pei Chun Kao. Featuring sharp angles, aggressive volleys, and expert analysis, this match crowns the best in British women’s doubles.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Watch Senior Pro’s John Sperling & Dave Weinbach v Stefan Andren & Rick Witsken in the second Semifinal match.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the NCPA Nationals in Saint Louis as the LMU Lions and Baylor Bears battle in a high-stakes best-of-seven series. The competition ignites with the Racing speed of rapid-fire volleys during an intense "equipment battle" between the power of the Selkirk Boomstick and the precision of Team Joola. Masterful Skills are on display as athletes execute flawless Around the Post (ATP) winners and tactical dink rallies that keep the pressure mounting. Amidst the Freestyle creativity of the collegiate circuit, witness morale-shifting momentum swings and desperate scrapping for every point as these top-tier programs fight for national dominance.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League (WPBL) continues on Day 5 at the CCI Brabourne Stadium with a clash between Mumbai Pickle Power and the Chennai Super Champs.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, watch a thrilling collegiate pickleball battle between Purdue University and Creighton University. Tied at 2-2 entering the broadcast, this match features intense mixed doubles action that decides the series.Key matchups include Purdue’s Emma Jones and Jay Barath facing off against Creighton’s Russell Lee and Lucy. Later, Purdue’s Caleb Young and Tammy Lamb take on Creighton’s Noah Wodzinski and Elizabeth Cook.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Witness a battle for survival at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai as two powerhouse teams, the Rajasthan Titans and Pune United, fight to secure their first tie victory of the season. The energy is palpable as Pune United's Katie Morris looks for redemption after a tough opening night, while the Titans rely on the aggressive play of Lorena Dupnik and the "superb power" of volleyball-pro-turned-pickleballer Isabella Nelson. From the intense "grind" of 15-minute singles matches to the high-speed tactical exchanges of men’s and women’s doubles, every point is a step toward climbing the league ladder. Don't miss the strategic masterclasses, including high-stakes challenges and game-changing "Pickle Plays," that keep the Mumbai crowd on the edge of their seats.

The game begins with a highly anticipated Men's Singles match featuring Mumbai's American star Brandon Lane against Bengaluru's Jack Foster. The match lives up to the hype, showcasing fierce action.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, hosts the high-stakes Women's Doubles Open Final featuring Team England against Team Spain. Defending champions Spain, represented by the powerhouse duo of Sabrina Mendez and Glauka Carvajal, look to secure their second consecutive title against the English pair of Thaddea Lock and Katy Morris.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: We are live in sunny San Diego for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This high-stakes collegiate team match features the University of San Diego (USD) battling Grand Canyon University (GCU) in a best-of-seven series.The action includes intense Men's Doubles , Women's Singles , and Mixed Doubles as these teams compete for regional dominance. Watch top talent, including GCU's lefty powerhouse Adam Jones, who boasts a strong 5.6 singles rating , and his partner Xavier Cook Nakakuki. On the USD side, the episode highlights the partnership of Marcus Hopkins and Ryan, an impressive grad student player with high doubles ratings. USD’s Bella also shows grit in the women's singles match. This broadcast captures the best of college pickleball in an amazing format.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the final showdown of the league stages as Delhi Dilwale and the Rajasthan Titans clash in a high-stakes battle for pride and final positioning. The atmosphere is electric as Rajasthan’s Lorena Dupnik delivers a "professional performance" in a come-from-behind singles victory against Delhi’s Mehek Kuan, setting a fierce tone for the tie. Witness a tactical masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the relentless power of Max Mantor and the "next level" skills of Trang Huynh as they attempt to dismantle the Titans’ defensive wall. With veteran Rob Cassidy making his highly anticipated men's doubles debut, every rally becomes a desperate fight for dominance in the season's final league encounter.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: We are live from the Barnes Tennis Center in San Diego, California, for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This thrilling collegiate team match features Grand Canyon University (GCU) taking on the University of Hawaii. The broadcast picks up in the heat of the action during a crucial mixed doubles game, with GCU leading. Watch as the match extends into a dramatic Sudden Death Dreambreaker (Game 7) to decide the winner. The episode highlights the unique collegiate format where every point counts towards seeding for the National Championship. Key players include Hawaii's Tristan Simmons and Tama, battling against GCU's Tanner and Hannah. The match concludes with a high-stakes finish that determines who moves forward in bracket play.

programme.desc: In this US Open 2025 Pro Women's Doubles match, the Waters duo (Anna Lee Waters and Lee Waters) take on Amanda Rosati and Kaitlyn Campbell. They also discuss the challenges of the progressive draw format in pickleball and preview Anna Lee Waters' upcoming mixed doubles match with Andre Agassi.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025, this pivotal collegiate team match features Kennesaw State (KSU) facing off against Virginia Tech. The action kicks off with a mixed doubles showdown chosen by coin-toss winner Virginia Tech.Watch as Virginia Tech's Cody Miller and Heather Murphy bring their A-game against KSU's Yuri Yadi and Sophia Fiona. The match also features men's doubles with Kellen Funk and Cody Miller representing the Hokies, while Parth Modi and his partner fight to keep KSU's hopes alive. With crucial seeding for bracket play on the line, both teams battle through intense rallies and strategic plays in this pool play matchup.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.desc: Miami Blaze face Punta Gorda Tide in match 3 of AFPL 2026 at Epic Athletic Club. Blaze lead 2-0 while Tide are 0-2. Kyler and Gianna for Blaze, Ariel and Jenna for Tide. Blaze have 7 subs this stop.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: It's Bobbi Oshiro and Megan Fudge versus Mari Humberg and Martina Frantova in a Women's Pro Doubles match at the US Open Pickleball Championships 2023.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League Season 2 continues its high-energy opening day at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai with a star-studded clash between Delhi Dilwale and the Chennai Super Champs. Watch as international stars like Delhi’s Max "Purple Jesus" Manthao and Chennai’s Hwang Nam Lee—a former Wimbledon junior doubles champion—bring world-class precision to the court. With celebrity co-owner Samantha cheering from the sidelines and strategic masterclasses from coach Wesley Gabrielsson, this tie features a gauntlet of intense Women’s Singles, Men's Singles, and high-speed Doubles matches. Experience every "Ernie" shot, tactical "pickle play," and the longest video challenge in league history as these two powerhouse teams battle for early-season dominance.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2022
programme.desc: The 2022 Picklebowl offers an unforgettable mixed doubles match featuring some of the biggest names in sports. US Olympian Casey Patterson and pickleball pro Chuck Taylor join forces to take on pickleball standout Megan Fudge and former tennis world No. 5 Kevin Anderson. Set against the scenic backdrop of Sea Island, Georgia, this unique event blends elite pickleball play with charity and college pride. Expect explosive rallies, pinpoint accuracy, and powerful serves in this high-energy exhibition that showcases the crossover appeal of pickleball.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The stakes reach their absolute peak at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for the first semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2, where there are "no do overs" for the Chennai Super Champs and Pune United. Witness a high-stakes tactical chess match as Chennai’s coach Jonny Goldberg makes the bold move to start premier player Rika Fujiwara against the "big and aggressive" Katie Morris in a critical women's singles clash. The intensity continues with a masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the powerful pairing of Lee Hwang Nam and Carlota Trevino facing off against Pune's consistent stars, William Sobeck and Magdalena Gregorio. Every point is a desperate grind for survival as these two titans battle through "world class" rallies for a guaranteed spot in the grand finale.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: It's a high-stakes "Wednesday evening pickleball party" on Day 6 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) as Pune United takes on the Chennai Super Champs at the CCI Brabourne Stadium. With both teams currently sitting low on the points table (fifth and sixth), this game is a crucial must-win for both, offering a chance for one team to gain much-needed inspiration and move up the standings.

programme.title: Pickleball England
programme.desc: Experience the exciting Women's Doubles Open 4.5+ Final from the 2023 English Open held at Bolton Arena, Greater Manchester. This match features dynamic teams: Megan Fudge and Susannah Barr face off against Lee Whitwell and Riley Bohnert in a highly competitive final. Follow expert commentary highlighting key plays including Susannah Barr’s precise lobs, Megan Fudge’s powerful forehand, and strategic teamwork. See how the match unfolds in a best-of-three games format with a hard stop on time. This showcase of top-level English pickleball captures the skill, tactics, and intensity of the sport. Stay tuned for post-match insights and upcoming mixed doubles action.

programme.title: VANTA Blackwater Team Cup
programme.desc: Megan Fudge and Amanda Hendry face Amelia Schmidt and Amber Pollicare in a pickleball match. Megan, a former field hockey player, and Jack Monroe discuss their preparation and excitement for the game.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Le duel entre Pégasus et Yugi est féroce. Comment Yugi peut-il gagner contre Pégasus, son Œil du Millenium et l’inviolable Monde des toons ?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi affronte Pegasus dans le royaume des ombres. Pegasus semble prendre l’avantage, mais rien n’est encore joué car Yugi prépare sa revanche.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pégasus a entraîné Yugi dans le Royaume des Ombres mais la tension mentale nécessaire au contrôle de ses monstres a raison de lui. L’autre Yugi, plus apte à survivre dans ce monde étrange, prend le relais. Le sacrifice de Yugi sera-t-il vain ?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Sans Yugi, son double qui partage son corps ne peut plus empêcher Pégasus de lire ses pensées. Cependant, les amis de Yugi unis par une profonde et sincère amitié font revivre son esprit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: En cherchant les âmes de grand –père et des frères Kaiba, Yugi découvre l’histoire de Pégasus et rencontre un personnage très énigmatique.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: L’âme de Makuba a réintégré son corps, et le grand-père de Yugi est parti de l’hôpital. Tout semble donc aller pour le mieux. Cependant…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Alors que Rebecca continue le duel contre Yugi, les grands-pères des deux combattants se racontent leurs péripéties en Egypte.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Les associés de Kaiba ont reprogrammé son jeu d'aventures virtuelles afin de se débarrasser de lui. Aussi Kaiba se retrouve-t-il prisonnier de son propre monde virtuel. Makuba appelle Yugi et ses amis à la rescousse mais ils ne sont pas au bout de leurs surprises…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pour rejoindre Kaiba, prisonnier dans un temple des montagnes, Yugi et ses amis doivent gagner la carte Niwatori. C'est Joey, affublé d'un ridicule déguisement de cochon qui affronte l'invincible Madame Butterfly. Mais la stratégie de cette dernière ne lui est pas inconnue...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Makuba a rejoint Kaiba et ils parviennent à échapper au fantôme spirituel. Ils retrouvent Yugi et ses amis, mais avant de pouvoir quitter le jeu virtuel de Kaiba, il leur faudra affronter le puissant Dragon mythique.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Duke Devlin projette d’anéantir Yugi afin de s’emparer de son titre de Maitre des Jeux –

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi affronte Duke Devlin dans une nouvelle version du duel de monstres

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Le match opposant Yugi à Duke Devlin continue, et le suspense est toujours haletant. Yugi peut-il remporter une partie de « Duel des monstres des dés» face au créateur de ce jeu en personne ?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Face à Duke Devlin, Yugi est en bien mauvaise posture. Mais il n’a pas dit son dernier mot.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Qui a pris l’apparence de Bandit Ken ? Yugi l’ignore. Pourtant, cet étrange personnage lui a volé son puzzle du millénium.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi doit affronter un mystérieux adversaire qui s’est emparé de l’esprit de Bandit Ken, pour récupérer son puzzle du millénium.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Le musée Domino s’apprête à recevoir l’exposition sur les Egyptiens de l’antiquité, présentée par Shizu Ishtar. Cette dernière va convoquer Kaiba afin de lui délivrer un important message.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yami est à la recherche de ses origines. Il va alors demander de l’aide à Téa, afin d’en savoir d’avantage sur son lointain passé.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Alors qu’il visite une exposition consacré à l’Egypte ancienne, Yugi et Téa rencontrent la mystérieuse Shizu. Pendant ce temps, Kaiba teste son nouveau système de disque de duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La petite sœur de Joey, Sérénity, va subir une opération des yeux. Joey doit donc se rendre à l’hôpital afin de la soutenir dans cette épreuve. Mais en chemin , il rencontre des pilleurs de l’ombre qui semblent bien décidés à ne pas le laisser passer.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: C’est Yugi qui inaugure le tournoi de Bataille ville, en affrontant un des pilleurs de l'ombre, Jack Hunter.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi affronte Jack Hunter afin de récupérer le Dragon noir aux yeux rouges de Joey. Mais le pilleur de l'ombre a l’intention de faire appel à Exodia. La partie s’annonce très serrée.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Espa Roba, un duelliste prétendant pouvoir lire les cartes de ses adversaires, provoque Joey en duel. Persuadé qu’Espa est un imposteur, Joey relève le défi.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey est en mauvaise posture face à son adversaire extra-lucide. Saura-t-il trouver les ressources nécessaires pour ne pas abandonner?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pour affaiblir Yugi, Marik envoie Arkana, le maître magicien. Mais Yugi n'est pas un adversaire comme les autres et ne se laisse pas impressionner par des tours de prestidigitation.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi livre un duel contre Arkana l'illusionniste. Pendant ce temps son grand-père et Téa le cherchent partout.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The drama continues as Dr. Phil goes on the hunt for con artists who cheat viewers out of thousands of dollars by posing as him and Robin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2013, Kelli Stapleton and her 14-year-old daughter, Issy -- who suffers from severe autism -- were found in the family van, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Could Kelli have done the unthinkable? In a Dr. Phil exclusive, the jailed Michigan mom opens up about what happened.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Doug and Debbie's once-perfect family has been shattered by the frightening reality that they could lose their 21-year-old son, Brandon, to drugs. Dr. Phil lays the groundwork for a successful intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, Gabby Petito’s parents speak out all together for the first time since the 22-year-old “Van Life” vlogger's body was discovered in Grand Teton National Park in Wyoming. As the manhunt for her fiancé, Brian Laundrie, continues, they share their knowledge about his survival skills, and talk about the heartbreaking moment her stepfather had to identify Gabby. They also honor her life and memory, and discuss what they hope will be her legacy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 2 of Dr. Phil’s exclusive interview with Gabby Petito’s parents, who are all sitting down together for the first time, they share where they believe Brian Laundrie may be hiding, and what they hope happens to him if he was involved in Gabby’s death. Plus, see their reaction to the latest developments in their daughter’s case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Fantomworks, Mécanos d'exception
programme.desc: Un peu à la manière de la série télévisée «24 heures chrono», nous passons la journée à l'atelier FantomWorks dont les quelque 85 clients s'attendent à ce que Dan accomplisse des miracles. Pendant que Steve s'acharne à réparer une moto BSA, Bobby doit résoudre un problème mécanique sur une Camaro 1969 qui a passé les quatre dernières années dans plusieurs ateliers de réparation. Il doit également terminer la restauration d'une GTO 1970 pour un combattant qui rentre sous peu au pays. Simultanément, Dan a des décisions difficiles à prendre relativement à une Valiant 1963 et une Grand National 1987 qui risquent de faire dérailler ses plans.

programme.title: V6

programme.title: Fantomworks, Mécanos d'exception
programme.desc: Mickey n'a qu'une idée en tête et même Dan n'arrivera pas à le faire changer d'avis. Même si sa Chevelle est déjà parfaite aux yeux de toute l'équipe de FantomWorks, il tient absolument à y apporter des modifications. Au contraire, Thom, lui, ne veut faire faire que l'essentiel sur sa Studebaker. Malheureusement pour lui, Dan trouvera des problèmes de taille sur sa voiture: de nombreuses fuites, des systèmes défaillants et un plancher ne tient plus en place que grâce à de la colle et du tapis

programme.title: Style in Steel
programme.desc: Style In Steel révèle non seulement les marques et les modèles qui ont laissé une trace indélébile dans le monde de l'automobile, mais aussi pourquoi et comment ces voitures spécifiques sont devenues si importantes pour l'histoire de l'automobile elle-même.

programme.title: Vegas Rat Rods
programme.desc: Steve Darnell et son équipe de spécialistes des rat rods sont passés maîtres dans la fabrication d’automobiles. Ils opèrent depuis un vaste garage, le Welder Up, en périphérie de Las Vegas, et transforment pour des clients excentriques de vieux modèles en exemplaires uniques dans le style Mad Max "rat rod". - Du levier de vitesse en forme de fusil de chasse aux des feux arrière en bocal en verre, des sièges façon chaise électrique aux pédales d'accélérateur en fer à cheval, chaque rat rod présenté dans VEGAS RAT RODS est un mix de vieille auto, de performance high tech et l'imagination débridée de Darnell et de toute son équipe. Dans chaque épisode de Vegas Rat Rods, Steve et son équipe construiront une nouvelle voiture pour un client exigeant en moins de 5 jours.

programme.title: Kars and Stars
programme.desc: Nous visitons le Petersen Automotive Museum à Los Angeles pour l’exposition Bond in Motion, qui présente les véhicules originaux de la franchise James Bond. Les spectateurs découvrent de près les voitures les plus emblématiques associées au plus célèbre agent secret du monde, 007.

programme.title: Fantomworks, Mécanos d'exception
programme.desc: George confie sa Mustang Mach 1 1971 à Dan, convaincu qu'elle ne nécessite que quelques travaux mineurs, mais ce n'est pas le cas. Son châssis est complètement déformé, quelqu'un ayant déjà utilisé l'auto pour effectuer des cascades. Lorsque l'atelier du Texas auquel Mick a confié la restauration de sa Mercury Woody 1952 ferme ses portes, il fait appel aux services de Dan qui est bientôt littéralement obligé de recoller les morceaux de sa vieille voiture.

programme.title: Fantomworks, Mécanos d'exception
programme.desc: Rick est le fier propriétaire d'un corbillard tape-à-l'œil qu'il veut équiper de nouveaux gadgets et rendre plus performant. Il repartira avec un véhicule dont la banquette rabattable laisse plus de place à un cercueil et qui est équipé d'un système de sonorisation qui pourrait réveiller les morts, d'une machine à fumée, de squelettes, et de deux lance-flammes, et qui ne laisse personne indifférent. Merlyn et Lynn, des fermiers du Minnesota, confient à Dan une camionnette Chevrolet Apache qu'ils n'ont pu conduire que dans leur allée. De fait, le véhicule était si dangereux, que Merlyn l'avait entreposé dans sa grange pendant trois ans.

programme.desc: Rick est le fier propriétaire d'un corbillard tape-à-l'œil qu'il veut équiper de nouveaux gadgets et rendre plus performant. Il repartira avec un véhicule dont la banquette rabattable laisse plus de place à un cercueil et qui est équipé d'un système de sonorisation qui pourrait réveiller les morts, d'une machine à fumée, de squelettes, et de deux lance-flammes, et qui ne laisse personne indifférent. Merlyn et Lynn, des fermiers du Minnesota, confient à Dan une camionnette Chevrolet Apache qu'ils n'ont pu conduire que dans leur allée. De fait, le véhicule était si dangereux, que Merlyn l'avait entreposé dans sa grange pendant trois ans.

programme.title: Style in Steel
programme.desc: Style In Steel révèle non seulement les marques et les modèles qui ont laissé une trace indélébile dans le monde de l'automobile, mais aussi pourquoi et comment ces voitures spécifiques sont devenues si importantes pour l'histoire de l'automobile elle-même.

programme.title: Vegas Rat Rods
programme.desc: Steve Darnell et son équipe de spécialistes des rat rods sont passés maîtres dans la fabrication d’automobiles. Ils opèrent depuis un vaste garage, le Welder Up, en périphérie de Las Vegas, et transforment pour des clients excentriques de vieux modèles en exemplaires uniques dans le style Mad Max "rat rod". - Du levier de vitesse en forme de fusil de chasse aux des feux arrière en bocal en verre, des sièges façon chaise électrique aux pédales d'accélérateur en fer à cheval, chaque rat rod présenté dans VEGAS RAT RODS est un mix de vieille auto, de performance high tech et l'imagination débridée de Darnell et de toute son équipe. Dans chaque épisode de Vegas Rat Rods, Steve et son équipe construiront une nouvelle voiture pour un client exigeant en moins de 5 jours.

programme.title: Kars and Stars
programme.desc: Nous rencontrons l’acteur John Schneider, qui parle de la célèbre General Lee de la série Dukes of Hazzard et de la Bandit Trans Am, aux côtés de Gene Reynolds, constructeur de ces deux voitures iconiques, et de John Schinella, designer de la Trans Am. Nous rencontrons également le constructeur du van Mystery Machine ainsi que le directeur artistique des films Scooby-Doo.

programme.title: Style in Steel

programme.title: Fantomworks, Mécanos d'exception
programme.desc: George confie sa Mustang Mach 1 1971 à Dan, convaincu qu'elle ne nécessite que quelques travaux mineurs, mais ce n'est pas le cas. Son châssis est complètement déformé, quelqu'un ayant déjà utilisé l'auto pour effectuer des cascades. programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Crémieux a été arrêté. Tandis qu’il est interrogé par la police, Marcel prend contact avec Bériot afin d’opérer un rapprochement entre les deux partis.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: La ferme de Marie a été placée sous surveillance policière. Jean est bien décidé à faire tomber tout le réseau, mais doit faire face au départ de Rita, partie sans laisser de trace après avoir découvert les mensonges de ce dernier.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Tandis que Marie et les gaullistes s’organisent pour tenter d’échapper au piège tendu par les gendarmes, Jean n’a plus qu’une seule idée en tête : sauver la femme qu’il aime…

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Antoine (22 ans), frère de Joséphine, ancienne domestique et nouvelle épouse de Raymond Schwartz, est appelé au STO mais parvient à s’enfuir. En planque, il va rencontrer Claude, 20 ans, élève au conservatoire d’art dramatique, lui aussi en cavale. Chassagne, nouveau maire de Villeneuve, collaborateur affiché et amant officiel de Jeannine, est victime d’un attentat contre sa personne. Il y échappe mais durcit la répression contre les résistants et les réfractaires.Marcel et Suzanne continuent leur activité dans la résistance en planifiant une nouvelle action, mais Suzanne est tiraillée entre son activité clandestine et le soudain retour de guerre de son mari (Gérard) qu’elle n’a pas vu depuis 3 ans. A l’école, Bériot et Lucienne accueillent une nouvelle maîtresse de chant : Margueritte.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Antoine et Claude, toujours en fuite, se planquent dans une ferme puis dans la forêt. Mais très vite se pose la question de comment subsister et manger dans ces conditions. Les communistes (organisés en secret dans la forêt) attaquent un camion allemand … mais cela tourne mal et une fusillade éclate. Marcel et Suzanne s’en sortent, mais cette dernière est de plus en plus tiraillée par ses problèmes personnels depuis le retour de son mari. - L’attaque du camion allemand provoque la colère d’Heinrich Muller qui exige des arrestations sommaires dans Villeneuve. Par ailleurs, il utilise Hortense dans le but d’obtenir d’elle de la morphine pour calmer ses douleurs de plus en plus vives.A l’école, Marguerite, la nouvelle venue, attise les soupçons de Lucienne sur sa véritable identité.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Claude et Antoine (et des camarades) se posent la question de l’entrée en résistance après une rencontre avec Marie. Finalement ils intègrent le maquis (les M.U.R) et une relation particulière s’instaure entre Marie et Antoine. Daniel (désormais installé à Moissey avec Sarah, Gustave et Te Quiero) accueille Ezéchiel (auteur de l’attentat contre Chassagne) blessé à l’épaule et recherché par la police.A l’école, Marguerite, la nouvelle venue, attise les soupçons de Lucienne sur sa véritable identité.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: La vie dans le maquis est de plus en plus pénibles. Antoine tente de mobiliser les troupes avec des entraînements quotidiens mais le moral est bas ; Claude propose de les initier au théâtre. Déstabilisée par la souffrance et les sarcasmes d’Heinrich, Hortense décide de lui trouver de la morphine, quel qu’en soit le prix. Joséphine ne supporte plus d’être sans nouvelles de son frère ; elle décide d’aller le retrouver, malgré les mises en garde de Raymond. Marguerite demande à Bériot de la faire entrer dans la résistance et se rapproche petit à petit de Lucienne

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Suzanne ne supporte plus les remarques blessantes de Marcel ; la mission commune qu’ils doivent accomplir tourne court. La vie suit son cours chez Daniel ; Sarah et les enfants préparent en secret sa fête d’anniversaire, Ezechiel s’apprête à quitter la maison… C’est alors que Daniel est contraint de se rendre dans le maquis, pour soigner un soldat allemand blessé et capturé par Antoine et ses hommes. Suite à son escapade dans le maquis, Joséphine et Anselme sont arrêtés et interrogés par la police. A l’école, la complicité entre Marguerite et Lucienne ne fait plus aucun doute.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Suite à la mort de Joséphine et aux arrestations, le maquis doit déménager. Raymond est au plus bas et pense à quitter Villeneuve. Antoine ne se fait pas à l’idée d’avoir perdu sa sœur. Marcel, emprisonné avec Raoul (fils de Marie) et Anselme (membre du maquis), et condamné à mort, reçoit la visite surprise de Suzanne qui annonce qu’elle fera tout pour les libérer. Elle entre alors en contact avec Marie pour unir leurs forces.Daniel, toujours retenu, échafaude un plan d’évasion mais cela tourne mal … Son avenir est lié aux évolutions du camp. A Villeneuve, les douleurs d’Heinrich poussent Hortense à tout pour obtenir de la morphine … comme à céder au chantage de Chassagne.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Antoine, Marie, Suzanne et les membres réseau réfléchissent à un plan pour faire évader Marcel , Raoul et Anselme de prison. A Villeneuve, Heinrich met Hortense dehors après avoir découvert son mensonge sur la provenance de la morphine ; elle se refugie chez Daniel, dans leur ancienne maison, où elle retrouve Gustave et Tequiero affamés et livrés à eux-mêmes. Suite à la mort de Joséphine et l’enquête sur les maquisards s’enlisant, Jean perd son titre de chef de la police. Eliane, sa domestique et informatrice, qui a la mort de Joséphine sur la conscience, tente de mettre fin à ses jours.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Antoine et Raymond ont réussi à faire évader les prisonniers et tous rentrent triomphalement au maquis ; seul Marcel n’a pas pu s’échapper, Suzanne est anéantie. A l’école, l’amitié entre Marguerite et Lucienne se brise après que cette dernière ait découvert ce que Marguerite cachait depuis son arrivée. Daniel est autorisé à quitter le maquis pour tenter de faire libérer son frère. Il rentre à Moissey où seuls l’attendent les agents de la Milice… pendant que les chefs de maquis se réunissent pour décider de leur action du 11 novembre.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Arrêté par la milice puis torturé par les allemands, Daniel est emprisonné avec Marcel. Heinrich et Hortense, de leur côté, forment une étrange famille recomposée avec Gustave et Tequiero. Alors qu’Antoine et Marie répètent les rôles principaux de la pièce de théâtre qu’ils devront jouer le 11 novembre, Antoine découvre la liaison de Marie et Raymond ; piqué au vif et contre l’avis de tous, il décide de changer tous les plans et d’organiser un défilé de l’armée des maquisards dans Villeneuve.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: 11 novembre 1943. Les maquisards sont prêts à défiler. Ils n’attendent plus qu’un dernier signal, celui qui confirmera que la radio allemande de l’école a bien été débranchée. Chassagne, qui a compris qu’il se passe quelque chose de grave, tente de prévenir le commissariat puis les allemands de l’école ; Lucienne, qui doit accomplir la mission de sabotage, est prise au piège mais réussit finalement à s’échapper et retrouve Marguerite dans sa chambre pour regarder le défilé. Les maquisards investissent la place de Villeneuve ; un vent de libération souffle sur la ville.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Tout le maquis est en effervescence suite au défilé, mais à Villeneuve les représailles ne se font pas attendre. Les autorités allemandes et françaises procèdent à de nombreuses arrestations et s’affrontent, chacun accusant l’autre de négligence. Heinrich en profite pour se venger de Chassagne. Arrêté et emprisonné, il retrouve Marcel, dont l’exécution est prévue pour le lendemain… Bériot, de retour de Lyon, apprend toute l’opération par Marguerite et Lucienne. Cette dernière est terrorisée par les conséquences possibles de ses actes…

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Interrogée et mise sous pression par Jean Marchetti, Marguerite vend le maquis pour protéger Lucienne. Informés de la situation, Antoine et ses hommes doivent fuir. Marchetti veut agir vite mais le sous-préfet Servier l’en empêche, préférant laisser l’opération aux allemands… L’étau se resserre dangereusement autour du camp.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: La guerre tire à sa fin et les membres de la résistance se rassemblent pour préparer l'arrivée des Alliés. Les allemands semblent se retirer peu à peu, mais est-ce bien vrai ?

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: La guerre tire à sa fin et les membres de la résistance se rassemblent pour préparer l'arrivée des Alliés. Les allemands semblent se retirer peu à peu, mais est-ce bien vrai ?

programme.title: Un Village Francais

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Automne 1945 : Le procès de Daniel Larcher et du sous-préfet Servier débute. Bériot ne peut plus être maire après l'annulation des résultats de l'élection. Antoine est démobilisé et rentre à Genève avec la promesse d'un avenir commun. Hortense souffre de solitude en dépit de la présence de Daniel et est de plus en plus distraite.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Jeanine est convoquée devant le comité d'épuration de Villeneuve dont Raymond est membre. Suzanne et Loriot essaient de ramener Gustave sur la bonne voie en lui enseignant les valeurs et idéaux de son père Marcel. Lors du procès tout le monde attend le témoignage d'Heinrich Müller.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Bériot a perdu contre son propre parti et il fait payer à Lucienne le prix pour son manque d'amour. La jeune Léonore est tombée amoureuse de Gustave sans savoir combien cette situation est dangereuse. Les communistes veulent gagner les prochaines élections et pour ce faire ils utilisent l'image de héro de Marcel.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Jeanine encourage Raymond à présenter sa candidature en tant que maire de Villeneuve sur la liste De Gaulle. Il doit convaincre Antoine d'accepter la préparation d'une cérémonie en mémoire de quatre résistants qui ont choisi de se sacrifier pour sauver le reste du groupe....

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: Marchetti s'apprête à être exécuté et il accepte de témoigner en faveur de Larcher, à condition que Rita et leur fils David soien trouvés et rapatriés. Loriot fait l'impossible pour protéger Gustave et Léonore même s'il doit pour cela mettre sa carrière en jeu.

programme.title: Un Village Francais
programme.desc: L'heure est aux souvenirs, aussi bien pour les communistes que les Gaullistes. Raymond n'est pas convaincu mais devient officiellement candidat à la mairie de Villeneuve. Pendant ce temps, Gustave est intimement persuadé par la nécessité d'un engagement politique. Côté procès, le tribunal s'apprête à rendre son jugement.

programme.desc: Una joven desarrolla un gusto por la sangre humana después de una cirugía plástica experimental, y sus víctimas se convierten en zombis sedientos de sangre, lo que provoca una epidemia en toda la ciudad.

programme.title: Extinción
programme.desc: Cuando una enfermedad desconocida aniquila a la mayor parte de la población mundial, un hombre con una sangre única es aislado para su estudio. Temiendo por la seguridad de su esposa, rompe la cuarentena y se adentra en un mundo devastado, lleno de infectados monstruosos y perseguido por una agencia sospechosa.

programme.title: La posesión de Emma Evans
programme.desc: Harta de un ambiente familiar que considera excesivamente asfixiante y autoritario, Emma Evans, una adolescente problemática e insatisfecha, decide liberarse de esa atmófera opresiva. Para conseguirlo, da rienda suelta a sus deseos más ocultos, sin sospechar que desencadenará oscuras y poderosas fuerzas que no podrá controlar y que traerán el horror y la tragedia al hogar de los Evans.

programme.title: Rec 3: Genesis
programme.desc: Koldo y Clara están hechos el uno para el otro. Van a celebrar su enlace acompañados de sus seres queridos. Pero una negra sombra se cierne sobre ellos. En el día más feliz de sus vidas, el infierno va a desatarse. Precuela de la saga de terror.

programme.title: Los Hijos de Allen Funt
programme.desc: Entre las paredes de una habitación blanca, cinco personas viven confinadas. A diario, son obligadas a participar en una votación que permitirá al ganador lograr la recompensa prometida de salir al exterior. Uno de ellos tendrá la oportunidad de conseguirlo.

programme.title: REC 4: Apocalipsis
programme.desc: Una desafortunada reportera de televisión es rescatada y enviada en un viaje a través del océano, pero es seguida por el virus mortal que la ha asolado a ella y a muchos otros.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys take a Jeep from meh, to mean - when they install a new long arm suspension kit to get this Jeep Wrangler Unlimited ready for the trails.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: This 2010 Camaro will soon be churning out close to 1000 Horsepower, so Kevin and Willie get it ready to handle that power by installing a new Ford 9 inch, new rear axle shafts, and a new drive shaft.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno take a stock TJ and make it into the machine it was born to be. Once we upgrade the Steering and Suspension, we’ll make some much needed repair.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: We bring our 2011 Cam Am Commander back for some final fixes. We beef up the steering with an electric power steering kit and throw some light on the subject with a large LED Light bar.

programme.title: Truck U

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Why do head gaskets keep failing on Ford 6.0 Powerstroke Trucks? The EGR Cooler is starting to fail. Matt and Bruno will show you how to delete the problem for good on Truck U.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: We’ve got a bright yellow C7 in the shop today and Kevin and Willie are installing new specialized long tube headers, exhaust and other extras to make this already robust platform even more powerful.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. Along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau. Chris and Casey are on the search for some large bucks, as well as showing the people at the camp a great time and what deer season is all about.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Skyler keeps it incredibly fun for his young boys while introducing them to hunting. Jackson is trying to fill his early season Kansas tag during the youth portion of the season. Although it's early they weren't expecting any velvet bucks!

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: After not hunting Kansas for a couple of years Nate Flynn returns to the sunflower state to hunt with friend and client, Curt Wittman

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In Season 4 Episode 4 of HLM, Summer work is in full swing in Missouri! Food plots are going in, season prep is underway, and just about everything that can go wrong does. We battle through it, get the job done, and finish things off with some favorite hunts from the past years.

Adam returns to Ohio with renewed determination after his Illinois success, setting his sights on a massive 10-point buck that's eluded him twice during the rut. With the season winding down, every moment counts as he pursues what could be the second giant of his dream season. The pressure is on to make it happen before time runs out.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: With few mature bucks to hunt Dean heads out to put his time in regardless because anything, can happen.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Hunting has a way of grounding us, reminding us of what truly matters: shared moments and unforgettable memories. Chance and Ashleigh Eckert are on their first out-of-state hunt in the rolling hills of Ohio. After overcoming a life-changing kidney transplant, their story is one of faith, love, and resilience. While the goal was a big buck, the true reward was the time spent together and the lessons learned along the way. Because hunting is about so much more than the harvest — it’s about the journey.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: There's nothing quite like bowhunting the Iowa rut, especially when you're chasing mature whitetails from ground level! After years of waiting to draw the coveted Iowa archery tag, Phillip Vanderpool with The Virtue TV finally gets his opportunity to be back in Iowa bowhunting. This is what November dreams are made of!

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Years of hunting the same piece of ground teaches you that some patterns are worth trusting. WoodHaven’s Josh Anderson heads back to the family property for a mid-October hunt, relying on years of history and a pattern that has produced time and time again. With the calendar lining up, Josh climbs into a stand that seems to come alive around the same time every October.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: Join The Bearded Buck as we head over to Kip Adams, the Chief Conservation Officer for The National Deer Association, home farm to discuss the deer/habitat management tips and tactics that he uses to help him and his family have success each and every fall.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: For many protected reserves across Africa, the elephant populations are expanding, and this comes with a critical problem: what happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Here's a look at the Realtree Road Trip crew's 2024 Franchi turkey shotgun setups. Michael Pitts and Bryan Brown get the Franchi shotguns unboxed and ready for the 2024 turkey season.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Realtree's Ben McDonald gets luck again on his first sit in Nebraska. This time he rattles in an absolute giant whitetail into Bow Range.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Michael Pitts is joined by competition caller and call-maker Anthony Virga, as well as Cole Barthel. It's the first hunt of the year for the Realtree Road Trips crew.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Gobblers are on fire in Georgia during the middle of April. Tyler Jordan is hunting with Turkeys for Tomorrow sweepstakes winners Jaryd and Kelli Hurst. Kelli is after her first turkey and just needs a little luck. Ole Miss Athletic Director Keith Carter also makes a visit to Realtree Farms to hunt.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: After a tough go at it in Oklahoma, Rigsby Stewart gets back to his home turf in East Georgia. This turkey gobbled his head off! Sweet redemption in the Georgia Pines!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Realtree's Chipper Jones bow hunts Kansas whitetails during the late rut.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven working on some Big Tine clover maintenance and getting the plot he killed the Boss 8 in during rifle season ready to go. Tune in and get some tips for your clover plots and watch Randy take out the oldest deer on the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are in Missouri at the Raven and they are ready to burn some powder and get rifle season kicked off at the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy and Cody are back on the Raven in Missouri and with opening day of bow season fast approaching they are scrambling to get all the final prep work done and correct any mistakes they might have made along the way.

programme.desc: If you had a blank check to build the best fishing boat possible, what would you create? Capt. Justin gets his wish, but it doesn’t come quickly or easily.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin takes a fellow guide on his new boat to see how it measures up. Using only public waypoints on his Humminbird unit, they find exploring to be as much fun as it is fruitful.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: It’s that time again—when the boys from StruttinBuck load up and head out of Arkansas, bound for Fairfield, Texas and the FE Hill Ranch. Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that’s grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: This week we dive into whitetail anatomy to explain the science behind a humane harvest. Learn how the mediastinum and thoracic pressure dictate lung collapse after a shot, see how these biological insights pay off during a challenging rut hunt, and get tips on spring food plot preparation.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: The introduction of non-native species into Australia has had a large impact on native species. Ongoing management throughout the country is a daily task. Dan Cabela meets some of the people taking on this challenge.

programme.desc: When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it’s time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43’ custom ACI Catamaran "Killer Bee". Armed with the right crew, the right gear, and a never-quit mindset, the guys roll the dice on an overnight move—hoping to wake up to redemption and put a few quality bluefin on deck.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake, Part Two
programme.desc: This show was filmed in late October of 2019. Four months prior, in June of 2019, Tim Carnahan was diagnosed with Glioblastoma, Brain Cancer. According to Tim's medical team, his life expectancy could be between three months and 18 months. Fast forward to now, 2020; today's update is one we hoped would never come. With a heavy heart and tear-filled eyes, we share with you that Tim Carnahan has passed away after battling for close to 12 months. It only fits that the last words to pass his lips were I love you, Lory, and keep fishing. While his time on earth was cut short, the amount of joy he experienced and shared with others was genuinely tremendous and will never be forgotten. If you would like to help out in any way, lory and friends have put together a Go Fund Me page to ease the financial burden of medical bills and afford lory some time to greave and transition into life without Tim. We love you, Tim. Rest in peace, buddy.
